messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — GPU cluster west-1: sustained VRAM usage + ECC error spikes on multiple nodes (gpu-west-12, gpu-west-14). Multiple 5xx observed upstream. Triggered at 15:02 UTC. Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/gpu-health?var-cluster=west-1 :rotating_light:
Sam (oncall): ack. I'm on it. Pulling prometheus and node state now. Will try lightweight mitigation first (drain/quarantine) to avoid mass fallbacks.
Ali (sre): quick check shows short ECC bursts coincident with thermal spikes. Node gpu-west-12 has repeated ECC counts, 14 has intermittent. Logging full `dmesg` from 12 now -> looks like driver resets around 15:01-15:03.
Julia (runtime): starting an emergency routing change to steer non-enterprise traffic away from west-1 to avoid customer impact. Pushed quick rule: `if region==west-1 and customer_tier!=enterprise -> fallback-smaller-kv` (will monitor).
Maria (support): two customers reported 502/503s: acme-corp and beta-analytics between 15:02-15:10. I collected request ids and opened support threads. Telling them we have mitigation in progress.
Kai (eng-infra): during initial drain cpu/gpu temp on 12 spiked to ~85C briefly, then dropped. I'm starting `nodectl drain gpu-west-12 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=120`. Monitoring thermals and soak.
Sam (oncall): to cut alert noise while drains finish I'm adding a temporary silence for HighVRAM on cluster=west-1 for 30m: `alert-manager silence add matchers='{alertname="HighVRAM",cluster="west-1"}' duration=30m`. Silence created: SIL-1234.
Ali (sre): we should not blanket-silence; propose we modify rules instead — require sustained signals and make ECC rate-based. Current rules are too eager (instant ECC >0 triggers and VRAM 1m average).
Sam (oncall): patching staging rules now. Current snippet:
```
- alert: HighVRAM
  expr: gpu_vram_used_percent > 90
  for: 1m
```
Proposed change:
```
- alert: HighVRAM
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_vram_used_percent[5m]) > 92
  for: 5m
```
And ECC rule from instant to rate-based:
```
- alert: ECCSpike
  expr: increase(gpu_ecc_errors_total[2m]) > 0.5
  for: 2m
```
Will run quick smoke in staging then roll to prod.
Julia (runtime): monitoring routing traffic shift. Fallbacks reducing KV cache pressure on active nodes ~10% so far. Good sign.
dashboard-bot: Draft dashboard created for post-incident review: https://grafana/redwood/d/zzz/gpu-health-post-incident (private until PR). Panels: per-node VRAM %, ECC rate timeline, thermal histogram, drain events overlay.
Maria (support): customers updated about mitigation and that we will follow up with timeline and RCA. They asked for ETA to normal service — any estimate?
Kai (eng-infra): drain finished for gpu-west-12; node is in maintenance. Marking gpu-west-14 for hardware follow-up and quarantining: `kubectl label node gpu-west-14 quarantine=true`. Planning hardware ticket (TKT-321) for morning swap.
Sam (oncall): rolling the alert rule changes to prod now. Leaving SIL-1234 in place while we verify the mitigation and avoid noisy pagers. If error rate across west-1 >1% we will remove silence and escalate.
Ali (sre): post-incident tasks I'm tracking: 1) PR for alert rule changes (#456), 2) Grafana dashboard PR (dash-789), 3) run alert-silence audit to ensure no blindspots, 4) colo hardware ticket (TKT-321). I'll own the alert PR.
Julia (runtime): also adding a fallback policy change: when region load > 85% automatically route to smaller-KV model to reduce VRAM pressure (PR #457).
Sam (oncall): updating incident playbook: add "only create silence when concurrent node-drain in progress" and prefer rate/duration based ECC alerts. Will file playbook PR.
Maria (support): I'll draft customer-facing summary for impacted accounts and send after postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status: downgraded to P3 at 16:05 UTC — routing + drain mitigations succeeded, error rates back to baseline. Investigation open for root cause (likely transient ECC + thermal driver resets).
Sam (oncall): setting follow-up postmortem at 17:00 in #incidents. Please attach any query links, `dmesg` excerpts, and grafana panels in the doc. Marking this thread resolved for paging; keep it open for action item updates. :thumbsup:
